name: congress-abstract-review
description: AI-assisted evaluation of congress abstracts and expanded abstracts, one submission or a committee batch: deterministic compliance checks against the event's edital (word/character limits, sections, figures, references, language, blind review), detection of results that are only promised, a panel of independent evaluators (compliance, data & rigor, track & impact) or a single evaluator with escalation of borderline cases, barema scoring adapted to each track's nature (research, innovation, extension) and to the abstract's area and research approach, with an approve/reject decision (presentation modality and posters are left to the committee), and evaluation sheets (MD + PDF), feedback to authors and a committee spreadsheet ranked by track. Output is a draft for human committee members.

author.name: Prof. Dr. Fabiano Bezerra Menegidio (LaBiOmicS / UMC)
